caseName: Western Union Telegraph Co. v. Louisville & Nashville Railroad
caseNameFull: Western Union Telegraph Company v. Louisville & Nashville Railroad Company

opinions.text: December 6,1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied. Mr. Alexander Pope Humphrey, Mr. Rush Taggart, Mr. Francis Raymond Stark, Mr. W. Overton Harris, Mr. Edward P. Humphrey and Mr. William W. Crawford for petitioner. Mr. Helm Bruce, Mr. Henry L. Stone and Mr. Edward S. Jouett for respondent.
